# Phase Two — Realistic Relationship Architecture

The Awtsmoos gives Chesed the dream and Gevurah the measured edge; Awtsmoos.com should strengthen the living relationship graph by strengthening its proven owner.

## Evidence

- ProfileFollowController currently scans offsets 0..800 by 200, potentially five sequential requests and 1,000 records.
- SocialGraphApi follow/unfollow responses are opaque to callers and should not be treated as relation snapshots.
- NetworkPanel is authoritative-on-load and read-only.
- PeoplePanel renders discovery cards without follow state.
- Profile reloads after successful mutation.
- Backend follow storage is `/social/aliases/{alias}/following`, one array bounded to 1,000 records.
- Social Kernel intentionally marks semantic follows as non-persisted.

## Chosen implementation

1. Add a pure point-status helper beside existing profile follow functions.
2. Add a specific GET status route beside `/follows/:alias`.
3. Keep list/follow/unfollow routes unchanged.
4. Add one frontend SocialGraphApi method and SocialHubApi delegate.
5. Rewrite ProfileFollowController to make exactly one relationship-status request.
6. Preserve request-sequence stale protection, self/logged-out behavior, mutation disable state, and post-mutation Profile reconciliation.

No new storage keys. No global cache. No fake mutual state.
